asciichat_error_t acip_packet_encrypt (crypto_context_t * crypto, const acip_packet_plan_t * plan, buffer_domain_t * domain, void * ciphertext, size_t capacity, packet_header_t * header, size_t * length)

Encrypt a successful encrypted plan into caller-owned ciphertext storage and construct its wire header. The caller chooses contiguous or vectored delivery, and must release storage only after delivery has consumed/copied it. This helper owns and releases only its temporary gather buffer, allocated from domain. Output length is zero on failure; no output may be sent on failure.
